title: GCPO: Diagnosing and Constraining Subspace Geometry in Rollout RL for LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2608.11674v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: On-policy rollout methods such as GRPO are central to post-training of large language models, yet they frequently suffer from training instabilities, cross-task capability degradation, and response-length inflation. Although prior work has characterized the subspace geometry of aggregate updates, the stepwise variation of this geometry and its relationship to model performance remain unclear. We introduce Principal-Subspace Overlap, a dimension-corrected measure of individual rollout updates relative to the dominant singular subspaces of pretrained weights. Despite low average overlap, transient spikes often precede performance degradation. To address this, we propose GCPO (Geometrically Constrained Policy Optimization), which applies hard bilateral orthogonal projections to constrain updates to the complementary subspaces, preventing such excursions by construction. translated_title: GCPO：诊断并约束大语言模型滚动强化学习中的子空间几何结构
translated_abstract: 基于策略的滚动方法（如GRPO）是大语言模型后训练的核心，但它们经常遭受训练不稳定、跨任务能力下降和响应长度膨胀的问题。尽管先前的研究已经表征了聚合更新的子空间几何结构，但该几何结构的逐步变化及其与模型性能的关系仍不清楚。我们引入了主子空间重叠（Principal-Subspace Overlap），这是一种针对个体滚动更新相对于预训练权重主导奇异子空间的维度校正度量。尽管平均重叠度较低，但瞬态尖峰往往先于性能退化出现。为解决这一问题，我们提出了GCPO（几何约束策略优化），它应用硬性双边正交投影来约束更新到互补子空间，从而通过构造防止此类偏移。在数学推理、代码生成和工具使用任务上的实验表明...
tldr: 本文提出GCPO方法，通过硬性正交投影约束策略更新的子空间几何，有效防止大语言模型滚动强化学习中的性能退化。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces GCPO, which applies hard orthogonal projections to constrain subspace geometry in policy updates, effectively preventing performance degradation in rollout RL for LLMs.
